title: ridi-check
description: Compare two versions of a retrieval-augmented assistant on matched items. Repeated runs estimate an execution floor (re-execution noise). The release gate is an application of the item-level labels. Version 0.10.1 does not compute the manuscript's exact test. The manuscript 'Identical relevance grades cannot certify retrieval-augmented AI answers' is under review; a preprint is forthcoming.
